C5 the saved mask comes from comparing each cell's 2016-06-01..08-31 SST to a single region-wide threshold indexed by %j ordinal day (153-244), whose 31-day wrapped smoothing draws on raw thresholds for ordinal days 138-259; each raw threshold is the hazen 90th percentile of all region cells' baseline values on dates with exactly that %j (no ±5-day window). Hence baseline days span May 17-Sep 15 in leap years and May 18-Sep 16 otherwise, with every sea cell contributing to the pool and to its own comparison."}
